Maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're launching a pilot backup childcare stipend for the upcoming SF + PDX onsite week (Apr 6–10). If you need day-of backup care to attend, Redwood will reimburse up to $150/day (max $600 for the week). You can book via our pre-screened vendors or submit receipts. Links and workflow below.
Lina (Eng): Amazing, thanks!! Does this cover last-minute daycare closures?
Maria (People Ops): Yes. Covers licensed backup providers, short-term drop-in care, or hiring a paid nanny/au pair specifically for onsite days. Not for ongoing tuition. If your regular daycare closes and you hire backup to cover the day, that qualifies.
Jordan (Finance): Reimbursement steps: use expense code `POPS-CHILD-2026` and tag project "onsite-care". Attach itemized receipt and provider contact. We will fast-track approvals for expenses dated Apr 6–10.
Facilities Bot: Booking portal (vetted vendors): https://rwd.co/onsite-childcare — providers pre-screened (background checks + liability). For privacy-only bookings, tick the "People Ops only" box on the form.
Sam (Platform): Quick Q — if I reimburse my partner/family member who watches our kid while I'm at onsite, is that eligible?
Maria (People Ops): If you pay an outside provider (not on Redwood payroll), yes. For family members (partner/grandparent) we can reimburse up to $100/day for this pilot but require a signed attestation form. DM me for the attestation.
Lina (Eng): What about contractors (1099) or vendor employees who are parents?
Jordan (Finance): Contractors on 1099 and third-party vendors are NOT eligible for this pilot. We can revisit expanding eligibility next quarter depending on uptake.
Maria (People Ops): To enroll, fill this short form by Mar 29: https://rwd.co/care-pilot. Capacity for the first 120 requests; prioritization for caregivers traveling to attend onsite.
Sam (Platform): Awesome, submitting now.
Maria (People Ops): Operational note — include provider name, dates, and total on the expense. For the expense code, copy/paste: ```POPS-CHILD-2026```
Jordan (Finance): Tax note: reimbursements under $600 for ad-hoc care in this pilot are being treated as non-taxable per benefits counsel; we'll send an official FAQ after enrollment closes. Receipts still required.
Maria (People Ops): I'll follow up with an email with the short policy, FAQ, and booking link. Ping me @Maria (People Ops) if you have edge cases and I'll triage.
